definitions.explanation: A prefix used to describe something of small to medium scale, most commonly used with businesses.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧。
examples.english: To support small and medium-sized enterprises.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Small and medium enterprises are the foundation of the Japanese economy.

examples.japanese: {中小|ちゅうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even small and medium-sized companies can expand overseas.

notes:
{中小|ちゅうしょう} combines ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (medium) and {小|しょう} (small). Almost always used as a prefix before nouns, especially in business and economic contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}: small and medium enterprises (SMEs)
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業庁|きぎょうちょう}: Small and Medium Enterprise Agency
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: small-to-mid-size manufacturer
- {中小|ちゅうしょう}{規模|きぼ}: small-to-medium scale

USAGE:
{中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう} is by far the most common compound. SMEs make up over 99% of Japanese businesses, so this term appears frequently in news, policy, and economic discussions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|だい}{企業|きぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧: large enterprise
- ⟦{零細|れいさい}{企業|きぎょう}→零細企業：27027_reisaikigyou⟧: micro enterprise (even smaller than {中小|ちゅうしょう})
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧: major company (commonly used in business news)
